sources.label: Morphe patches for streaming and news phone apps: skip ads, block tracking, and
sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Block analytics & tracking
Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Disable AI
Removes Yahoo Scout and its entry points, Ask AI on selected text, the AI Analyst, and the AI insight cards.
GmsCore support
Signs in with Google through GmsCore instead of Google Play services.
Hide Plus upsells
Removes the Yahoo Finance Plus banners, sheets, and cards, and the Coinbase referral button. Locked features still show the paywall when tapped.
Hide pop-ups
Removes the rating and feedback requests, announcements, tours, coach marks, and tooltips. Privacy and consent screens still show.
Skip ads
Removes the ads on Home, Markets, quote pages, and news, and the ads in videos.

sources.label: Test patches
sources.author: Edoardo9708
patch_list: Yahoo Finance - Analysis diagnostics A7
Logs finance analysis response status and local subscription access outcomes without changing results.
Yahoo Finance - GOLD diagnostic A3
Experimental: simulates GOLD in local subscription state. Server feature maps remain original; does not establish premium content access.
Yahoo Finance - microG login A5
Experimental: route Google identity sign-in/authorization to existing ReVanced GmsCore, using the bundled credential provider.
Yahoo Finance - Remove ads A2
Test: enables only the AdsFree UI check; leaves other subscription features and purchases unchanged. Logs YF-RemoveAds.
